metadata.description: Foundathyon's skills for coding agents — one source for Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: keel-docs
plugins.description: Write, extend and audit docs/ so it builds with `keel docs` and follows the Foundathyon documentation standard.

plugins.name: keel-release
plugins.description: Cut a release with keel: choose the next semantic version, bump the version files, pass the checks, and tag with `keel create-version` — asking before anything is pushed.

plugins.name: keel-setup
plugins.description: Prepare a repository for keel releases, or audit one: `.keel` from `keel init`, the Release workflow that confirms every version to keel-api, keel-api's canonical report-version.sh, docs/releases.md and the KEEL_CI_TOKEN credential — asking before CI or secrets change.

plugins.name: keel-cli
plugins.description: Use the keel CLI safely: create, promote and deploy versions through keel once CI passes, roll back automatically on failure, freeze scopes, read deploys, changes, status and redacted logs, and change Dokploy only through reviewed plans a person approves — never secrets on the command line.
